authored_by: Human Lead, ruling of 2026-08-23; transcribed by the orchestrator on that ruling
not_an_arm_deliverable: No arm signed this and no arm may. It is not corrected by rerunning an arm (0092 does not apply); it is corrected by the Human Lead re-diffing.

inputs_diffed.note: arm b's CORRECTED emission, NOT its superseded originals (0123)

coverage_of_this_diff._why_stated: A diff that reports only what it found does not say what it covered. An empty result and a clean result are the same value unless the coverage is printed.
coverage_of_this_diff._absent_slots: Continued floor and Continued width_pp, both populations -- structurally absent in both files
coverage_of_this_diff.what_agreed: every point estimate, numerator, denominator, on_population_n, bound floor, bound ceiling, bound width, conditional sub-interval width, Continued ceiling, three-ceiling sum, excess_pp and excess_pairs -- on BOTH populations, IDENTICAL TO SIX DECIMALS

cross_arm_divergences.search_record: Every published figure of the W091_s2_premiere arm compared on both populations: 50 point/count/bound figures, 12 level-CI endpoints, 12 movement endpoints. 4 further slots are absent on both arms and are not disagreements.

divergences.what: The confidence interval endpoints differ between the arms, in the last digits, on EVERY interval and EVERY movement: 12 of 12 level-CI endpoints and 12 of 12 movement endpoints. Maximum absolute difference 0.026934 pp on the level CIs and 0.000513 pp on the movements. No point estimate, count, bound, width, ceiling, sum or excess differs at all.
divergences.does_not_affect: Any point estimate or bound. The movement SIGN CLASS is the same on all 12 endpoints, so no conclusion that turns on the sign of a movement moves.
divergences.cause: ARM a's D3, and it is a SPEC GAP, NOT AN IMPLEMENTATION DEFECT. decisions/0103 and 0118 fix B = 10,000, the seed = 20260818, the resampling unit = account and the statistic = BOTH levels and paired movements. THEY DO NOT FIX THE RESAMPLING FRAME OR THE DRAW ORDER. Two implementations under one seed therefore draw different replicate sets, and the intervals differ by sampling noise alone.
divergences.neither_arm_did_anything_wrong: The spec does not say what they should have done. Arm a named its frame and draw order as a spec choice it was making; the divergence is the spec's silence made visible, which is what a dual control is for.
divergences._why_not_reconciled: CLAUDE.md: any divergence is either a bug or an ambiguity in the spec -- report it, do not reconcile it. Reconciling would pick one arm's frame and draw order and call it the answer, which is a spec decision and must be visible as one.
divergences.NOT_RULED_HERE: The draw order and resampling frame are NOT ruled by this entry. That remains the Human Lead's.

preserved_measurement_of_implementation_._why_preserved: HUMAN LEAD, 2026-08-23: once the resampling frame and draw order are fixed in the spec THIS BECOMES UNREPRODUCIBLE, and it is the ONLY quantification of implementation sensitivity this build will ever have. Recorded as a measurement in its own right, not merely as the evidence for a divergence.

what_was_held_constant._note: All four spec-fixed elements identical in both arms, verified in each arm's own record.

preserved_measurement_of_implementation_.what_was_free: the resampling FRAME and the DRAW ORDER -- fixed by no ruling at the time of measurement. This is what the measurement isolates.
preserved_measurement_of_implementation_.what_it_shows: Under one fixed seed and one fixed B, two independent implementations of an account-clustered bootstrap produced intervals differing on EVERY endpoint, while every point estimate, count and bound was identical to six decimals. The divergence is bounded at 0.026934 pp on levels and 0.000513 pp on movements, and NO movement changed sign class.
preserved_measurement_of_implementation_.what_it_does_NOT_show: It does not measure the sensitivity of any OTHER quantity, any other arm, or any other step. It is one arm setting, W091_s2_premiere, on two populations.
preserved_measurement_of_implementation_._status: PRESERVED. The frame and draw order are NOT ruled by this document.
